en: Watching; waiting for the next episode

zh: 亮出来的动作和封条对不上，作废
en: The revealed actions do not match the seal: void
The actions cannot be replayed: void
Finished; waiting for the joint reveal

zh: 这一局打完，由房主开下一局。
en: When this episode is over, the host starts the next one.
Waiting for the host to start.

zh: 房主掉线了，我来当房主
en: The host is offline; make me the host

zh: 都亮出来了。每个人的得分都是在你的浏览器里照着动作重放出来的。
en: Everyone has revealed. Each score was replayed in your browser from that player's actions.

zh: 还有 §0§ 个人在打。所有人都打完，成绩一起揭晓；在那之前谁也看不到谁的。
en: Still playing: §0§. Results are revealed together once everyone has finished; until then no one can see anyone else's.

zh: 连不上公共的中继服务器。可能是这个网络把它们拦了；换一个网络再试，或者过一会儿它会自己重连。
en: Cannot reach the public relay servers. This network may be blocking them; try another network, or wait a while and it will reconnect by itself.

zh: 这个房间已经有 §0§ 个人了，进不去。
en: This room already has §0§ people in it, so you cannot join.

zh: 没有找到这个房间。房间号可能输错了，或者里面的人都已经走了。
en: This room was not found. The code may be mistyped, or everyone in it has already left.

zh: 房间里有 §0§ 个人（最多 §1§ 个）
房间走公共的中继服务器，不需要账号。知道房间号的人都能进来，昵称、进度和这一局的动作会经过中继。
en: Rooms go through public relay servers and need no account. Anyone who knows the room code can join; nicknames, progress and this episode's actions pass through the relays.

zh: 先起个名字，别人才认得出你。
en: Pick a name first, so the others can tell who you are.

zh: 房间号是 6 位的字母和数字（没有 0、1、I、L、O）。
en: A room code is 6 letters and digits (no 0, 1, I, L or O).

zh: 最多八个人同时打同一局。打的时候只看得到彼此打到第几回合；所有人都打完，成绩一起揭晓，再和参照规则在同一局上比。
en: Up to eight people play the same episode at the same time. While playing you only see which round each of the others has reached; once everyone has finished, the results are revealed together and compared with the reference rules on the same episode.

zh: 你来当房主：选玩法，把邀请链接发给朋友，人齐了点开始。
en: You are the host: choose the game, send the invite link to your friends, and click Start when everyone is in.

zh: 填朋友给你的房间号；点邀请链接进来的话，已经替你填好了。
en: Enter the room code your friend gave you; if you came in through an invite link, it is already filled in.

zh: 房间走公共的中继服务器，不经过 GitHub，也不需要账号。关掉页面就算离开；所有人都离开，房间就没有了。
en: Rooms go through public relay servers, not through GitHub, and need no account. Closing the page counts as leaving; when everyone has left, the room is gone.

zh: room 房间 联机 多人 一起 实时 朋友
en: room rooms online multiplayer together live friends

zh: 最多八个人同时打同一局。打的时候只看得到彼此的进度，所有人打完一起揭晓。不需要账号，把邀请链接发给朋友就行。
en: Up to eight people play the same episode at the same time. While playing you only see each other's progress; the results are revealed together once everyone has finished. No account needed: just send the invite link to your friends.
